original_descriptions.description: A vehicle collision occurs at the intersection: a dark-colored car enters from the right, fails to yield, and collides with a vehicle traveling straight through the intersection (visible at frames 0:09–0:12). The impact causes both vehicles to skid violently across the road surface, with visible debris and loss of control—consistent with a road accident.

A vehicle (dark sedan) enters the intersection at high speed from the left, fails to yield, and collides with a white van turning right. The impact causes the van to rotate sharply and skid across the intersection; the sedan also skids post-collision. Debris is visible in the air immediately after impact (frames 2–3), and both vehicles come to rest in abnormal positions (frames 4–12), indicating a clear road accident.

A motorcycle is seen skidding and losing control near the intersection at approximately 10.0s–12.0s, then collides with a white sedan that is turning right. The impact causes the motorcycle to fall onto its side, and the rider is thrown off (visible at 11.0s–12.0s). This constitutes a clear road accident involving vehicle collision and rider ejection.

A white sedan collides with a motorcycle at the intersection around 14.5s–15.5s; the motorcycle is struck and thrown sideways, with visible skid marks and abrupt vehicle motion indicating a crash. The sedan continues moving after impact, while the motorcycle lies on the road surface—consistent with a road accident involving collision and potential injury.

post_bue.description: A vehicle (dark sedan) enters the intersection from the right and collides with a silver sedan traveling straight through the intersection at approximately 25.5s–26.5s. The impact causes the silver sedan to rotate sharply and skid across the road, indicating a clear collision. No visible debris or fire, but the sudden change in vehicle trajectory and contact confirms a road accident.

The impact causes the silver sedan to rotate sharply and skid across the road, indicating a clear collision. No visible debris or fire, but the sudden change in vehicle trajectory and contact confirms a road accident.

A vehicle (white sedan) enters the intersection at high speed from the left, fails to yield, and collides with a bus turning right. The impact causes the sedan to spin violently and skid across the intersection, while the bus is pushed sideways. Debris is visible post-collision, and pedestrians near the crosswalk react by scattering. This constitutes a clear road accident with vehicle collision and loss of control.

A vehicle (appears to be a white sedan) is seen skidding sharply across the intersection at ~31.5s, losing control and rotating nearly 180 degrees before colliding with or coming to rest against the side of a stationary bus at ~32.5s. The motion is inconsistent with normal traffic flow—no braking or turning signal apparent—and suggests a loss of control leading to a crash. Debris is not clearly visible due to resolution, but the abrupt, uncontrolled movement and impact with the bus strongly indicate a road accident.
